Package com.societegenerale.failover.observable.metrics

Class MetricsSummaryAggregator

java.lang.Object
com.societegenerale.failover.observable.metrics.MetricsSummaryAggregator
public final class MetricsSummaryAggregator extends Object
Pure MetricsSummary aggregation math, shared by every consumer that must combine several summaries into one (the shared-store cluster source merging per-instance snapshots, and the snapshot stores folding a pre-reset baseline into a live snapshot). Uses the same MetricsKpis formulas as every other source, so the merged shapes and rates are identical to local / Prometheus (design §4.4).

Aggregation is exact for counters (summed per API) and approximate for latency (count-weighted mean, max-of-max). Exception counts are summed by type, keeping the top 8.

Author:
Anand Manissery

    • merge

      public static MetricsSummary merge(List<MetricsSummary> summaries)

    • cumulativeTotal

      public static long cumulativeTotal(MetricsSummary summary)
      The monotonic cumulative total of a summary — every counter this framework publishes, summed. Grows with every metric event within one process lifetime, so a drop between two snapshots of the same instance can only mean the instance restarted and its counters reset.
      Parameters:
      summary - the summary to total
      Returns:
      the summed cumulative total across every API

    • isCounterReset

      public static boolean isCounterReset(MetricsSummary previous, MetricsSummary incoming)
      Detects a counter reset between two snapshots of the same instance.
      Parameters:
      previous - the instance's previously stored snapshot
      incoming - the snapshot just received
      Returns:
      true when incoming is a post-restart snapshot of the instance that produced previous — i.e. its cumulative total went backwards (counter reset, design §5.3)
